title: Remove the impossible None branch from CSR row-offset monotonic validation

gardener_decision.problem: CSR row-offset monotonic validation still carried an Optional previous-offset state and None guard for every offset even though canonical CSR row offsets start at zero and never decrease.
gardener_decision.change: Use the local integer sentinel -1 and compare previous_offset > item directly, deleting the impossible previous_offset-is-not-None branch without adding another validator.
gardener_decision.why_not_another_abstraction: The change stays inside the existing TypedRelationBlock constructor and introduces no helper, validator, cache, registry, backend, relation type, profiler schema, workflow path, or benchmark harness.
gardener_decision.semantic_boundary: Offset element type refusal, row-boundary/start-zero precedence, monotonicity refusal, common entry-count validation, and strict row ordering remain externally unchanged. A -1 first-offset regression proves the local sentinel cannot become accepted persisted canonical input.
